questions.question: Which letter is the 5th to the right of D?
questions.explanation: D is the 4th letter. 4 + 5 = 9, which is I.

questions.question: Which letter is the 3rd to the left of H?
questions.explanation: H is the 8th letter. 8 − 3 = 5, which is E.

questions.question: How many letters are there between C and J in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: C = 3 and J = 10. Letters between them: 10 − 3 − 1 = 6 (D, E, F, G, H, I).

questions.question: Which letter is the 8th from the right end of the alphabet?
questions.explanation: Position from the left = 27 − 8 = 19, which is S.

questions.question: Which letter is midway between B and H?
questions.explanation: B = 2 and H = 8. The midpoint is (2 + 8)/2 = 5, which is E.

questions.question: Which letter is the 4th to the right of M?
questions.explanation: M = 13. 13 + 4 = 17, which is Q.

questions.question: In the word TEACHER, how many pairs of letters have as many letters between them in the word as in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: Check every pair of positions and compare the gap in the word with the gap in the alphabet. The pairs that match number 3.

questions.question: If the letters of the word CALM are arranged in alphabetical order, the third letter from the left is
questions.explanation: The sorted word is A, C, L, M. The third letter is L.

questions.question: If the letters of the word BRAIN are arranged in alphabetical order, the middle letter is
questions.explanation: The sorted word is A, B, I, N, R. The middle (third) letter is I.

questions.question: Which letter is the 6th to the left of the 10th letter from the right end of the alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 10th from the right is at position 27 − 10 = 17 (Q). 6 places to its left is position 11, which is K.

questions.question: Which letter is the 9th to the right of the 12th letter from the left?
questions.explanation: The 12th letter is L. 12 + 9 = 21, which is U.

questions.question: How many letters are there between the 4th letter from the left and the 4th letter from the right in the alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 4th from the left is D (4). The 4th from the right is W (23). Letters between them: 23 − 4 − 1 = 18.

questions.question: The letter that is the mirror image of J in the alphabet (same distance from the other end) is
questions.explanation: J is the 10th letter. Its mirror is at position 27 − 10 = 17, which is Q.

questions.question: Which letter is the immediate predecessor of the 16th letter from the left?
questions.explanation: The 16th letter is P. The letter immediately before it is O.

questions.question: If the letters of the word DEPARTMENT are arranged in alphabetical order, how many letters remain in the same position as in the original word?
questions.explanation: Sorted: A, D, E, E, M, N, P, R, T, T against D, E, P, A, R, T, M, E, N, T. Only the last position matches (T).

questions.question: Which letter is the 11th to the right of the letter that is the 8th to the left of S?
questions.explanation: S = 19. 8 to the left: 19 − 8 = 11 (K). 11 to the right of K: 11 + 11 = 22, which is V.

questions.question: In the word DISCOVERY, how many pairs of letters have as many letters between them in the word as in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: Compare the gap of every pair of letters in the word with the gap in the alphabet. The number of pairs that match is 4.

questions.question: Write the letters of the alphabet in reverse order (Z first). Which letter is the 10th from the left in this arrangement?
questions.explanation: In the reversed alphabet the 10th letter is the 10th from the right of the normal alphabet: 27 − 10 = 17, which is Q.

questions.question: If the letters of the word STAR are arranged in alphabetical order, the letter that is second from the right is
questions.explanation: The sorted word is A, R, S, T. The second letter from the right is S.

questions.question: Which letter is the 4th to the right of the letter midway between D and N?
questions.explanation: D = 4, N = 14, so the midpoint is (4 + 14)/2 = 9 (I). The 4th to its right is 9 + 4 = 13, which is M.
